derivation:
by
  intro c; simp only [Subtype.exists, Subtype.ext_iff, RingHom.adjoinAlgebraMap_apply, exists_prop]
  exact (AlgHom.map_adjoin_singleton (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C) b).ge c.property
explanation: Instantiate the algebra homomorphism with the canonical map B →ₐ[A] C. The resulting equality says its image of A[b] is A[algebraMap B C b]; membership gives the required preimages. The candidate is proved independently.
